headline: OpenAI says new models better at migrating legacy COBOL code
summary: OpenAI says its newer models, including GPT-6.1 Sol, now have significantly better capabilities for writing and migrating software written in older programming languages such as COBOL, which it says could help banks migrate off old systems.

claims.statement: OpenAI says its newer models are significantly better at writing and migrating legacy code such as COBOL.

sources.quote: OpenAI says its models can help banks migrate from old COBOL programs
OpenAI says its models now come with better COBOL capabilities.
OpenAI confirmed that its newer models are much better at writing and migrating software in older programming languages.

claims.statement: The improved model is named GPT-6.1 Sol.

sources.quote: OpenAI says GPT-6.1 Sol is dramatically better at migrating legacy code
